text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritized list called the backlog. These tasks are often written as user stories, which describe what a user needs from the product. Every day, team members meet for a quick standup to share progress and solve problems. Through this iterative development, teams build the product step by step, test it regularly, and improve it based on feedback. Agile helps teams stay flexible and respond quickly to change.
